title: Scalar extension and finite inverse image on actual unit generators
statement:
Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of ℚ_l, with independent scheme and coefficient universes. Use the actual finite inverse images and scalar generators of [def-pur-strict-quotient-expressions] and the normalized scalar adjunctions of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Scalar extension commutes with finite geometric inverse image by a comparison satisfying the prescribed unit-generator formula, for every complex and every n ≤ m:

theorem strictScalarPullbackComparison {V W : Scheme.{t}} (g : V ⟶ W)
    (K : Complex l E W) (SW : CoefficientDerivedSystemTensors l E W)
    (DW : CoefficientFiniteQuotientCalculus l E W SW)
    (SV : CoefficientDerivedSystemTensors l E V)
    (DV : CoefficientFiniteQuotientCalculus l E V SV) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : n ≤ m) :
    ∃ χ, ScalarPullbackIdentification l E g K hmn χ

source.place: Tag 03EL: composition of inverse image and extension of scalars; adjunction units.

proof.text: Naturality of the actual sequence ring morphism gives the quotient-ring square. Compose sheaf module direct images around that square. Their comparison is identity on underlying sections. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives the ordinary scalar-pullback isomorphism, and its unit identity gives the specified generator formula. Apply mapHomologicalComplex and evaluate in each degree. The module also supplies private normalized-unit naturality calculations for the parent constructor proof.
